value.message: LabJack T7 Board (labjack_1): scan_rate_hz must be positive.
LabJack T7 Board (labjack_1): channel 1: range must be one of 10, 1, 0.1, 0.01 (volts).
LabJack T7 Board (labjack_1): channel 2: AIN1 is already used by channel 1.
LabJack T7 Board (labjack_1): channel 2: tc_type "": only type K thermocouples are converted so far.
LabJack T7 Board (labjack_1): channel 3: ain must be 0-13.
LabJack T7 Board (labjack_1): channel 4: a differential input must be an even AIN (it pairs with the odd one above it).
LabJack T7 Board (labjack_1): channel 4: a 4-20mA PT needs shunt_ohms.
LabJack T7 Board (labjack_1): channel 5: kind "STRAIN" must be one of PT, TC, LC, RTD, VOLTAGE.
LabJack T7 Board (labjack_1): channel 6: an RTD needs ljtr_ohms (the LJTick-Resistance's fixed resistor).
